assets.title: Fixed Y-Branch Roller Junction
assets.description: One original static Y-shaped baggage junction, counted as one prop. A single continuous thick concave Y transfer deck and a separately connected lower Y frame link one short inlet to two different short outlet directions. Each arm carries three fixed thick rollers with continuous integral solid axles, two end collars and two genuinely bored bearing blocks. Finite lower bore faces support every axle and opposed outer bearing faces meet its fixed collars. A thick splitter nose and four low outer guides leave two bounded open routes and all three full-width terminal mouths. Four grounded feet, four uprights, three transverse end bearers and six side beams form the complete support path. Three own port coordinates, directions, clear dimensions and the real deck-to-roller gaps and height step are recorded. No conveyor line, luggage, drive, swinging gate, control, text, texture, animation or scene. Opaque unlinked constant PBR materials; metres, native Z up, front inlet -Y. Fixed static geometry only: no automatic sorting, motion, turning or baggage trajectory, smooth or seamless transfer, capacity, pinch protection, structural stability, manufacture, installation, airport standard, load or safety certification. No compatibility with previous straight, corner, railway or other assets is asserted.
